rationale: With only 11 minutes to close, the stock has already recovered significantly from its gap-down open (low $46.66 to current $50.32), sitting at 80.8% of today's range with price below the 9-EMA ($50.72) and showing indecisive 1-minute candles with no clear directional momentum. The ATR of ~$0.20 on 5-minute bars makes meaningful profit targets difficult to achieve in the remaining time, and the broad market weakness (SPY -1.48%, VIXY +6.91%) adds uncertainty without a clear catalyst to trade against. The risk/reward does not justify entry this close to forced liquidation.
